title: jdx/aube
claim: aube — a Rust Node.js package manager by the maintainer of mise: auto-installs when you run a script, reads existing pnpm/npm/yarn/bun lockfiles in place, and jails lifecycle scripts — the strictest security defaults of any Node PM.
why_good: The lifecycle-script jail lands exactly on the npm supply-chain-attack wave (postinstall malware), and zero-migration adoption — it drops into your existing lockfile — removes the switching cost that kills new package managers. jdx's mise following supplies distribution most new tools never get.
value: 商业价值: package managers don't monetize directly — the opening is the security posture: an org-level layer (script-jail policy, registry firewall, audit trail) sold to teams out of the Socket.dev / supply-chain budget.
risk: pnpm, Bun and npm can copy auto-install and script sandboxing; sponsor-funded solo-maintainer economics (37signals, entire.io) sustain a tool, not a company — this may stay excellent OSS with no business attached.
